checks.name: Approved scalar-product synonym finds the real vector exercise
Unavailable entries are excluded by default, and explicitly discoverable
Every query token must match and case/prefixes normalize
Textbook title is not an exercise title or searchable leaked field
Proposed title and raw description are not displayed
Source change invalidates an old metadata selection
Raw Level eight, English UI and absent minutes never invent ratings
Locale fallback is generic and rejected credits links are absent
Author absence remains unknown and a directory is never credited as an author
Private source identity, raw keywords and renderer tokens are allowlist-excluded
License evidence is not turned into permission by metadata approval
Hostile-looking text stays inert and survives JSON roundtrip in preview

scope: Read-only source inventory and reference metadata projection/search checks. Not SQL, full-library importer, live frontend integration or compatibility recertification.
